disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mercury, lead, cadmium, zinc, copper and iron for five canned tuna products from Derna.

study.design: market survey of five canned tuna products, three replicates each
study.method: HNO3 wet digestion (APHA 2017) of 0.5 g, AAS for Pb, Cd, Zn, Fe, Cu; cold vapor AAS for Hg
study.qa: no CRM, recovery or LOD reported

findings.group: retail canned tuna product 1 (made in Libya), Derna stores
findings.integrity_flag: Table 3 prints Hg 0.0192-0.0387 µg/g, but the abstract and Section 3.2 state 0.192 to 0.387 (text also prints 0.0387); a tenfold conflict. Table value kept.
findings.notes: Three replicate cans per product; the table prints one value per product, presumably the mean. Packing medium (oil or brine) per product not stated.
